title: Credo (Josquin des Prez, Missa Cum iocunditate (=Missa Dirige))
desc: Josquin des Prez, Missa Cum iocunditate (=Missa Dirige), Credo. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue1007c); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
